svg.aria-label: Food Delivery Intelligence — 10M orders, from raw CSV to an AI-queryable warehouse.
svg.title: Food Delivery Intelligence — 10M orders, from raw CSV to an AI-queryable warehouse.
svg.text: 10M orders, from raw CSV to an AI-queryable warehouse.
Batch platform that lands Zomato-style delivery data in S3, models it in
Snowflake with dbt under Airflow 3, and puts guardrailed LLM analytics on top
through Azure AI Foundry, with SQL parsed and checked by sqlglot.
